title: right wing populism 2026 09 02
text:
Follow on Apple or Spotify. Listen on the Reuters app.
Far-right and anti-immigration parties are a diverse bunch when it comes to the economy. Host Carmel Crimmins talks to Catherine De Vries, head of political science at the IE School of Politics, Economics & Global Affairs, about the economic policies of right-wing populists as they lead opinion polls in Germany and France.
